settings.tab_content: 100% sustainably harvested European beech wood. Kiln-dried to prevent warping and splits.
Colored with non-toxic water-based food-grade dyes. Finished with pure organic beeswax. Zero VOCs or lead.
EN71-1/2/3 European safety tested. CE marked. ASTM F963 American safety standards fully certified.
Wipe clean with a damp cloth and mild organic soap. Do not submerge. Allow to dry naturally.
